name: Keg
ingredients: Wood (30), Copper Bar (1), Iron Bar (1), Oak Resin (1)
use: Turns fruit into Wine, vegetables into Juice, wheat into Beer, and hops into Pale Ale.

name: Preserves Jar
use: Turns fruit into Jelly, and vegetables into Pickles.

name: Cheese Press
use: Turns Milk into Cheese, and Goat Milk into Goat Cheese.

name: Mayonnaise Machine
ingredients: Wood (15), Stone (15), Earth Crystal (1), Copper Bar (1)
use: Turns Eggs (White, Brown, Duck, Void, Dinosaur) into premium Mayonnaise.

name: Oil Maker
use: Turns Truffles into Truffle Oil, and Corn/Sunflower into Oil.

name: Bee House
ingredients: Wood (40), Stone (8), Iron Bar (1), Maple Syrup (1)
use: Produces Wild Honey regularly. Produces Flower Honey if placed near fully-grown flowers.

name: Dehydrator
use: Turns 5x Fruits into Dried Fruit, or 5x Mushrooms into Dried Mushrooms.
